subject.title: Dashboard: stateful notes widget — the first consumer of widget write-back

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this enabled-by-default modular-dashboard program after requiring its persistence layer to be redesigned around the shared SQLite state architecture?
rationale: The PR adds a large bundled product surface, persistent state APIs, sandbox and asset-serving boundaries, and a default activation decision; those choices require explicit maintainer intent before substantial redesign or landing.

options.title: Sponsor an SQLite redesign
options.body: Approve the product direction and require named Control UI, plugin, state, and security owners to guide the redesign and bottom-up landing.

options.title: Pause the dashboard program
options.body: Keep the stack open without further landing work until maintainers decide whether OpenClaw should own this product surface.

options.title: Decline bundled ownership
options.body: Do not land the core stack and revisit the concept externally if approved plugin APIs can support it.

recommendation.title: Sponsor an SQLite redesign
recommendation.body: Approve the product direction and require named Control UI, plugin, state, and security owners to guide the redesign and bottom-up landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history combines ownership of an adjacent bundled Control UI plugin tab with recent shared SQLite state migrations.
